newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Reynolds Philippines '96 net at 194.778 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds Philippines '96 net at 194.778 mln pesos.

text.p: Aluminium producer Reynolds Philippine Corp said on Monday it had posted an unaudited net income of 194.778 million pesos last year, slightly higher than its target of 193.388 million pesos.
The company registered a net profit of 107 million pesos in 1995.
Reynolds' chief financial officer Jorge Navarra said in a statement the firm was forecasting a net income of 301.23 million pesos this year.

"The company's product rationalisation programme and the cost-saving measures implemented last year have significantly contributed to its sustained growth," Navarra told the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company said sales volume last year rose by 11 percent to 11,093 tonnes from 10,016 tonnes in the previous year.
Reynolds is set to list its shares in the Philippine Stock Exchange on Thursday, February 27.
